notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/interstitial encountered (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only standard account/cart/checkout/search/api/on-demandware.store disallows). Platform: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Sites-CasaViva-Site). Counts verified via the rendered result-count header (data-products-count attribute / 'N Resultados' text) on each SEO category URL; for categories at or under the visible page size, cross-checked against the count of unique data-pid product tile IDs in the server-rendered HTML (exact match confirmed on espejos=10, espejos-pared=8, cuadros-y-murales=3, lamparas-de-mesa=19, lamparas-de-pie=3, marcos-de-fotos=4, jarrones=4). For larger categories (platos, vajillas, copas, etc.) the rendered header count was used directly since tile count is capped by page size (Rule 1 default: trust the rendered N-items header). Also discovered and used the SFCC Search-Refinebar side-door (/on/demandware.store/Sites-CasaViva-Site/es_ES/Search-Refinebar?cgid=<id>) to double-confirm a genuinely empty category (relojes returned data-products-count=0 both via direct page and via this endpoint); note this side-door is rate/session-sensitive under rapid sequential calls (returned false 0s on a fast batch sweep), so final counts for populated categories were taken from direct SEO-page fetches, not the side-door batch. IMPORTANT: this SFCC catalogue exhibits recursive/aggregate category pages -- browsing a parent node (e.g. /salon/, /comedor/, /iluminacion/, /salon/velas-e-inciensos/, /salon/decoracion-salon/, /comedor/complementos-de-mesa/, /terraza-y-jardin/decoracion-de-jardin/) returns the union of its own + descendant products, confirmed by product-ID overlap (e.g. velas-decorativas product IDs are a subset of the velas-e-inciensos parent page's own product grid; decoracion-salon's 5 own product IDs are literally 2 espejos IDs + all 3 cuadros-y-murales IDs). Because of this, no qty was recorded on any such parent/branch-landing URL -- they are emitted as parent:true grouping rows only, and only the true leaf sub-category pages carry qty. /decoracion-pared/ (11 results) was proven to be the exact union of cuadros-y-murales (3) + espejos-pared (8) with zero extra products -- dropped as a duplicate type-rollup of already-counted leaves (Rule 0.6, same population under a second URL). /decoracion/ (top-level, 7 own products) mixes 4 IDs also found in espejos with 3 unidentified IDs, is not linked from the main mega-nav, and reads as a curated/featured landing page rather than a taxonomy node -- dropped as non-category/featured. /relojes/ (bare top-level clocks alias) returns an empty shell (no product grid, no title) and was replaced with the real nav path salon/decoracion-salon/relojes/, which itself verified as 0 products currently (page exists, 0 Resultados) -- so Casa Viva currently carries no wall clocks in the sub_category the site's own nav points to; excluded as empty, not skipped. Categories checked and found genuinely EMPTY (0 products, page exists with no product-grid, verified 245-247KB empty-shell HTML pattern): salon/decoracion-salon/relojes (clocks), centros-de-mesa, figuras-decorativas, topes-puertas, revisteros(also out of scope), bano/complementos-de-bano/espejos (bathroom mirrors -- checked deliberately under Rule 0.4/0.3 rather than skipped for the room word, currently 0 stock), iluminacion/guirnaldas, salon/velas-e-inciensos/candelabros, salon/velas-e-inciensos/velas-led, comedor/cristaleria-y-acrilicos/acrilicos, comedor/cristaleria-y-acrilicos/decantadores, terraza-y-jardin/decoracion-de-jardin/complementos-de-jardin. Excluded as out of scope: Home Fragrance (aromas-e-inciensos 'Difusores de aromas' 17, velas-aromaticas 'Velas aromaticas' 7 -- velas-decorativas was kept in scope after confirming via product titles ('Vela pilar', 'Set de velas candelabro') these are unscented pillar/decorative candles, a taxonomy sibling distinct from the aromatic-candle node); artificial flora (flores-artificiales 2, plantas-artificiales 2); all textiles (salon/textil-de-salon, comedor/manteleria, terraza-y-jardin/textil-de-exterior, bano/textil-de-bano, cocina/textil-de-cocina); all furniture (muebles/* entirely, muebles-de-dormitorio, terraza-y-jardin/muebles-de-jardin-y-exterior, parasoles-y-cenadores, barbacoas); cutlery (comedor/cubiertos/*); bar tools -- verified via product titles (corkscrews, bottle openers, cocktail jiggers, bottle coolers, ice buckets) under comedor/cocktail-y-vino/* (accesorios-para-cocktail 9, accesorios-para-el-vino 18, botelleros-y-enfriadores 3, cubitos-y-cubiteras 1); kitchen tools/appliances/cookware (cocina/* utensilios, organizadores, pequenos-electrodomesticos, ollas-y-sartenes, cafeteras-y-teteras, reposteria, picnic, cocinas-del-mundo, muebles-cocina); comedor/complementos-de-mesa/aceiteras-y-vinagreras (oil/vinegar cruets, kitchen tool) and saleros-y-pimenteros (salt shakers + wooden/acrylic pepper mills -- judged functional kitchen tool, product titles dominated by 'Molinillo de pimienta' grinders); comedor/complementos-de-mesa/aperitivos-y-tapas was KEPT (ceramic serving boards/bowls -- genuine decorative serveware, not a tool); bathroom hardware/storage/fixtures (bano/accesorios-de-bano, bano/organizadores-de-bano, bano/carros-de-bano, bano/complementos-de-bano/accesorios-para-colgar -- verified 1 item, a bamboo towel ladder, functional storage not decor); orden-del-hogar (home organisation/storage) entirely; all of navidad/* (Christmas/holiday, per Holiday & Gift exclusion); all promo/marketing/seasonal-duplicate trees: rebajas/* (sale), */black-friday/*, summer-market/*, campanas/*, special-price/*, new-era/*, clau-and-chloe/* (furniture brand collab), coleccion-*, inspiracion/*, marcas/* (brand listing), botanicals, madera-de-olmo-reciclada, slow-living, summer-house, vuelta-renovada, winter-essentials (none of these are real category nodes distinct from the ones already counted -- Shop-All/Collection/Featured style pages per the NEVER EXTRACT list). Rule 0 applied: Outdoor Lighting (terraza-y-jardin/decoracion-de-jardin/iluminacion-exterior, qty 7) INCLUDED despite the garden/outdoor room word; Garden Planters & Pots (maceteros-y-jardineria, qty 3, verified via product titles as ceramic/steel 'Macetero' planters, not gardening tools) INCLUDED despite the garden room word; Bathroom Mirrors was actively checked (not skipped) and found empty on merits, not room-bias. Rule 0.6 overlap documented: Mirrors (espejos, 10) and Wall Mirrors (espejos-pared, 8) are both emitted as siblings -- espejos-pared's 8 product IDs are a strict subset of espejos's 10 (the 2 extra items in the broader 'Mirrors' node are non-wall/freestanding mirrors); both are genuine, separately-linked nav nodes in the site's own taxonomy (an 'all mirror types' node plus an explicit wall-mirror sub-type), kept per Rule 0.3/0.6 rather than dropped as a facet re-cut. Dinnerware Sets (conjuntos, 17) and Porcelain Dinnerware Sets (vajillas-de-porcelana, 21) overlap by only 3 of their combined IDs -- kept as separate genuine nodes (general sets vs porcelain-specific complete sets).
